## Biographical Information

It is possible that CMY's Miss Cox is the same as the Agnes Cox who published <i>Zenza and Ounah, the Indian sisters, and other poems</i> (Windermere: Johnson 1887).  Miss Cox evidently knew the author of ['The Cardioscope'](../other_books/otherbook_612.qmd), an early series in <i>MP</i>, and perhaps that was written by [Harriet Lucy Cox](person_375.qmd), who is a probable early contributor.  However, there is little substantial evidence here.
